# criblio_monitor_shared_config (Resource)

MonitorSharedConfig Resource

Manages reusable monitor settings. Supply the partial upstream monitor configuration using `jsonencode(...)`. The fingerprint is computed by Cribl and can be used in monitor inheritance references. Remove this configuration from profiles before deleting it.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "criblio_monitor_shared_config" "my_monitor_shared_config" {
  config = jsonencode({firingCondition = {clear_delay = 60, fire_delay = 300}, priority = {value = "P2"}})
  id = "team-defaults"
  name = "Team Defaults"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tools/codegen -->
## Schema

### Required

- `config` (String) Partial monitor configuration carried by this shared configuration.
- `id` (String) Unique identifier for the shared configuration.

### Optional

- `name` (String) Optional human-readable name for the shared configuration.

### Read-Only

- `fingerprint` (String) Content hash maintained by the server, used by consumers to detect drift.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = criblio_monitor_shared_config.my_criblio_monitor_shared_config
  id = "example"
}
```

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import criblio_monitor_shared_config.example platform-priority
```
